s.how: Pick 500g grapes off the stem, wash and pat dry. Roll in the juice of a lime, then in 50g caster sugar. Spread on a lined tray and freeze for at least 3 hours. Serve straight from the freezer in a chilled bowl.

Butterfly 500g peeled green prawns, dip in flour, then 2 beaten eggs, then 60g panko mixed with 60g shredded coconut. Fry at 180C for 2 minutes. Blitz a mango with a little chilli and lime for the dip.

m.note: the dinner that turns into a fight
m.how: Soak 80g breadcrumbs in 100ml milk, then mix lightly with 500g beef mince, 250g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 1 egg and a splash of Worcestershire. Shape in a loaf tin, glaze with tomato sauce and bake at 180C for an hour. Serve with 1kg potatoes mashed and 300g peas.

w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk 4 eggs with 150g sugar until thick, fold in the chocolate and 100g almond meal. Bake at 160C for 35 minutes and cool. Pour over 100g chocolate melted with 100ml cream. No decoration, no capes.

d.note: ice cold, super suit or not
d.how: Add 150ml fresh lemon juice, 120ml sugar syrup, 10 mint leaves, 200ml cold water and 4 cups of ice to a blender. Blend 30 seconds until slushy. Pour into 4 glasses, leaving a little room, and top each with a splash of cold lemonade. Garnish with a lemon wheel and mint sprig.
